title: Rooftops of Crossroads
license: © CVET; reuse with attribution, non-commercial educational use only
notes: South Africa, c. 1985, no speech on the reel. A camera car drives Mhose Drive through the Crossroads squatter camp outside Cape Town: corrugated iron to the horizon, a face in the wing mirror, people at the roadside. All six windows are taken from the first nine minutes, which carry road and street sound at -17 to -23 LUFS; the tape's second half (interiors, washing, the rooftop panorama) is recorded 15-25 dB lower and would vanish under a single loudnorm. Fetched from the page's flat MP4, recordFiles/207-784-34/11x022-H.264LAN.mp4. Re-cut 2026-09-14 at --band low (highpass 60 Hz) so the road rumble survives; windows unchanged.
